''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

The Wheel of Time is ''Koło Czasu'' in Polish. The books were translated and published, sometimes in multiple volumes, in the year indicated in parenthesis.<ref>[http://pl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ko%C5%82o_Czasu_%28cykl%29 pl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ko%C5%82o_Czasu_%28cykl%29]</ref> There are various translators for the books, including Katarzyna Karłowska, Karłowski Jan and Ewa Wojtczak. The publisher is Zysk i S-ka.

There is a full set of audiobooks in Polish that include New Spring and are published by Storyside. The narrator is Jakub Wieczorek.

==Book covers==

===Zysk i S-ka (Third Edition)===
The most recent version of the books which began publication in 2019. The most recent was Winter's Heart published on 13 Sept 2022.[https://www.coprzeczytac.pl/wrzesniowe-zapowiedzi-fantasy-2022/] In addition, there is a rereleased cover of The Eye of the World that ties in with the Amazon TV series.

===Zysk i S-ka (First Edition)===
The books in Polish were originally released in two parts,  with the exception of The Path of Daggers and Winter's Heart. Most of the books mirror the original artwork in the English originals with either original artwork added for the second volume or the original artwork split over the two volumes.<gallery captionalign="center">
